units.source_text: 右边是覆盖着白雪的田野，左边沿着邻居的墙根种满了柿子树。

en.t: On the right were fields covered in white snow, and on the left, persimmon trees were planted thickly along the base of the neighbor's wall.
The front of the house looked like a flower bed.

units.source_text: 正中央有个小荷花池，池中的冰块已经被捞到池边，红鲤在池里游来游去。

en.t: In the very center was a small lotus pond; the ice from the pond had already been lifted out to the edge, and red carp swam back and forth inside it.

units.source_text: 房子也像柿子树干一样，枯朽不堪了。

en.t: The house too, like the trunks of the persimmon trees, had rotted into decay.

units.source_text: 积雪斑斑的屋顶，木板已经陈腐，屋檐也歪七扭八了。

en.t: On the roof, where snow lay in patches, the boards had already grown old and decayed, and the eaves were crooked and warped.
